Call with Plaza Motors Group — one of their smaller stores, St. Louis
market. Direct dealer relationship, not a group-wide buy.

Their agency of record, Redwood Creative, handles Plaza's print and radio
placements, but Redwood is NOT involved in this buy and is NOT taking a
commission on it — dealer wants to pay Premion directly. Keep our rates
net, no agency markup on this one.

What they want: in-market auto intenders, one line of Premion Streaming TV
against that segment.

Budget is firm at $4,000 for the flight. We agreed $29 CPM. I pulled
avails on the in-market auto intender segment for their DMA before the
call — comes back around 1,700,000 for the month. That's for context only;
she wants to know what percent of that a $4,000 buy at $29 reaches, not a
plan sized to hit a reach number.

Flight: October through December. Washington DC office on this one.
Monthly breakout on the plan.

No sports, no retargeting, nothing else discussed — just the one line.
